faq.title: Frequently asked questions
faq.subtitle: Everything to know before experiencing a signature dinner.

items.a: Dinédit creates unique experiences that blend gastronomy and art in unusual venues. Each dinner is designed as a moment out of time, where guests discover an artist, a chef and a secret place.

items.q: How do I take part in a dinner?
items.a: Simply sign up on the website or via our Contact page. As places are limited (usually 20 to 30 guests), we recommend booking as soon as a new event is announced.

items.q: How often do you hold public events?
items.a: We organise about one dinner a month, i.e. 10 to 12 dates a year.

items.q: How much does a “signature dinner” evening cost?
items.a: The price of a dinner from Dinédit's own programme varies according to the artist, the chef, the venue and the format of the evening. We aim to keep a rate of around €150 incl. VAT per person, with some exceptional editions offered at a higher rate. For a bespoke dinner, the price is drawn up on quotation.

items.q: Where do the dinners take place?
items.a: The venues are secret and unusual: artists' studios, private apartments, chapels, former factories, galleries, modernist houses, and more. The exact address is revealed only to participants a few days before the event.

items.q: Who are the guest chefs and artists?
items.a: Each dinner showcases a guest chef (sometimes starred, sometimes emerging) who cooks a unique menu inspired by the event, and an artist (painter, musician, photographer, performer, designer, etc.) who shares their world with the guests. The line-up is always different to surprise participants.

items.q: Do the menus take dietary requirements into account?
items.a: Yes. When booking, please let us know about any allergies, intolerances or specific diets so the chef can adapt the menu.

items.q: Is it only for art or food lovers?
items.a: Not at all. Our evenings are for anyone curious and open-minded. Whether you're an art lover, a foodie, or simply after an original experience, you're welcome.

items.q: Can I come on my own?
items.a: Of course. Many participants come alone and use the dinners to make new connections in a friendly atmosphere.

items.q: Is it only for French speakers?
items.a: French, English, Dutch… and often more: these dinners also attract a very international crowd!

items.q: How many people attend each event?
items.a: The evenings are human-sized, usually limited to a maximum of 30 guests, to ensure closeness and exchange with the artists, chefs and other guests.

Becoming a member (€75/year) gives you a preferential rate of -15% on every dinner, access to the photo gallery of past evenings, an introduction to other members on request, and priority information about future exclusive Dinédit events.

items.q: How can I keep up with upcoming events?
items.a: Just reach out via our Contact page to be added to our mailing list, and follow our news on Instagram: @dineditbxl.

founders.intro: Fany Ramadier and Serge Van Mol have very different backgrounds — she in France, he in Belgium.
founders.serge: Serge is from Brussels and trained at the Fine Arts. An entrepreneur at heart, he specialises in organising events for companies. He knows artists, passionate collectors and chefs, and never stops meeting new ones and sharing their worlds.
founders.fany: Fany is Parisian and comes from the corporate world of customer experience. Curious about others, she loves bringing together people of all ages and walks of life. A freelance consultant, she helps companies develop sustainable strategies and circular projects… values she also applies to Dinédit!
founders.genesis: Blending genres and cultures is their great passion. On their travels, in New York or London, they discovered the concept of exclusive dinners and secret cinema — evenings held in secret places, reached through the back door of an antique dealer known only to insiders. With Dinédit, they set out to create that dynamic in an intimate approach. In 2017 they launched the signature dinners, challenging themselves to shake up conventions and change habits… because adventure sometimes begins just around the corner.

esg.title: Our ESG charter
esg.subtitle: A concrete commitment, from choosing producers to managing waste.

environment.title: Environment
items: We favour seasonal, local and responsible cuisine, working with committed chefs.
We work with local producers and passionate artisans, such as Domaine du Chenoy, whose Belgian sparkling wines Perle de Wallonie (Belbul-certified) elevate our food-and-wine pairings.
We reduce food waste by adjusting quantities and cleverly reusing surpluses.
Our dinners are adorned with local, seasonal flowers for elegant, planet-friendly settings.

social.title: Social
items: We bring together artists, chefs, artisans and guests in a spirit of exchange, transmission and cultural diversity.
We support emerging talents by offering them visibility and collaboration opportunities.
We favour intimate tables to encourage human exchange, conviviality and the creation of genuine bonds.
We put our network and visibility at the service of associations such as CREHAM, helping them gain recognition and create meaningful encounters for their cause.

governance.title: Governance
items: We work with transparency and integrity, respecting people and partnerships.
We foster lasting collaborations with our partners, in a logic of mutual trust.
